## What's Changed
* fix: explicit support for Android 15 by @gilbsgilbs in https://github.com/whew-inc/FakeGApps/pull/28
* fix: bump version code by @gilbsgilbs in https://github.com/whew-inc/FakeGApps/pull/29
* fix: `SigningDetails` signature mismatch in Android 9 by @gilbsgilbs in https://github.com/whew-inc/FakeGApps/pull/31

## What's Changed
* fixed signingInfo spoofing on Android 9 to 12 by @gilbsgilbs in https://github.com/whew-inc/FakeGApps/pull/25

## What's Changed
* Cleanup and modernize build system by @nift4 in https://github.com/whew-inc/FakeGApps/pull/21
* Add spoofing of SigningInfo to fix Android >= 9 by @gilbsgilbs in https://github.com/whew-inc/FakeGApps/pull/23

## What's Changed
* Add android 13 support by @haridhayal11 in https://github.com/whew-inc/FakeGApps/pull/11

# FakeGApps
Used in combination with [MicroG](https://microg.org/) to enable Google Cloud Messaging (GCM) and much more without proprietary Google Play Services.

Supports Android 4.0 - 14

[Original repository](https://github.com/whew-inc/FakeGApps)
